about: Firmware (lib/engine/firmware.ts) is the host's class. Each has an `identity`: its own rule (`perks`), its heat style, and its Overload ultimate (`surge`: piledriver, overwatch, blink, overrun). with firmware loaded, its attack takes Strike's place, and the firmware grows over many hosts. Every room fight won with it loaded gives it xp (an elite more, a boss or the chapter's set piece most); its level never resets on death. Each firmware's attack starts from `base` and its damage is `scale` times the wearer's physical attack; every level from 2 adds what it lists (scale and heat add up, the rest replace). `xpToNext[n]` is the xp from level n+1 to n+2. Enforcer (melee) opens with a host death once 5 enemies have been beaten in all; Operative (ranged) opens when a host dies at threat 11 or deeper; any firmware with `unlockAt` opens when a host wins a room fight at that threat or deeper. A level step may also add `speed` (the host's speed while it's loaded) or `twin` (act twice in a turn: 'cool' while at 40 heat or less, 'always' every turn).

identity.rule: A takedown gives you another action.
identity.heat: Runs hot fast: +3 heat on every hit, and venting bursts hit 50% harder.
identity.ultimate: Piledriver: twice your best move on everyone within 2 tiles, and knocks them back.

base.name: Hydraulic Slam
base.description: Volkov operator firmware: the whole frame behind one blow. Reaches two tiles in a line.

identity.rule: Acts twice in a turn while you start it cool (25 heat or less).
identity.heat: Runs cold: sheds 3 more heat every turn.
identity.ultimate: Overwatch: a free precise shot at every enemy within 6 tiles.

base.name: Precision Shot
base.description: Kizuna targeting firmware: a shot down a straight line of four tiles.

levels.text: Goes through every body in the line
Clean line: hits far harder, through cover

identity.rule: A free step after every attack you make without moving first.
identity.ultimate: Blink: vent all your heat and act again at once, hasted.

base.name: Flicker Jab
base.description: IOA limiter-free firmware: a jab so quick the arm is back before the hit lands. One tile next to you.

levels.text: Hit and run: step back after the jab
Afterimage: act twice in a turn while you're cool

identity.rule: Every hit pushes 6 more heat into whoever it lands on.
identity.heat: Cooks crowds: get them to 100 and they overheat.
identity.ultimate: Overrun: shove everyone within 3 tiles back and pump 50 heat into each.

base.name: Crowd Press
base.description: Tianxia labour firmware: a shoulder through the crowd. Sweeps the three tiles in front of you.

levels.text: Clear the floor: hits all eight tiles around you
Overrun: a blast on a 3x3 square up to three tiles away
